Definition: a stronger form of G3303; a particle of affirmation (only with G2229); assuredly:--+ surely.
BiblicalUsage: Men is the stronger particle, assuredly, surely, and it only ever stands beside its partner. Acts 7:20 says Moses was born in the time when he was exceeding fair, and Galatians 4:10 rebukes the church for observing days, and months, and times, and years.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a particle this small still matters, because it marks the places where the writers lean hard on what they are saying.
